create.name: Kanga Studio Nairobi
create.bio:
Kanga Studio is a yoga and wellbeing centre off Peponi Road in Nairobi, with a timber-lined practice room looking onto a garden. Its founder, Emma Bonnici, teaches Kanga Yoga, the studio's own multi-style approach, which draws on the teachings of Swami Sivananda, B.K.S. Iyengar and K. Pattabhi Jois and puts adapting the practice to each person ahead of fixed forms. Teachers wear white at the studio, and philosophy, chanting and ceremony sit alongside asana.

The school trains teachers through a Yoga Alliance-certified 200-hour course in two parts: 150 hours taught live online by senior teachers based in Rishikesh, covering asana, pranayama, meditation, yoga and Ayurveda philosophy, bhajans and puja, and a 50-hour in-person module in Nairobi on teaching method, adjustment and class planning, capped at ten students. Further 100-hour courses run in Rishikesh and Arusha. Day to day, a large team teaches Kanga, Hatha, Ashtanga, Jivamukti, Vinyasa and Yin classes, meditation and pranayama, and the studio hosts visiting teachers for chanting, breathwork and sound sessions and leads retreats to Rishikesh.

courses.title: Kanga Yoga Teacher Training: 50-Hour In-Person Course, Nairobi
courses.description: The in-person half of Kanga Yoga's 200-hour training, held at the Nairobi studio each morning except Sundays and limited to ten students. Led by Emma Bonnici, it centres on teaching method, hands-on adjustment, paired teaching and class planning, and is also open to teachers who already hold a qualification. The 150-hour online part runs beforehand.

courses.title: Rishikesh Yoga & Ayurveda Retreat with Emma Bonnici
courses.description: A week in Rishikesh by the Ganges with the studio's founder, built around daily yoga and meditation in the Himalayan foothills.

courses.title: Om Chanting with Khilan Shah
courses.description: A donation-based session of Om chanting in the studio garden led by Khilan Shah, a teacher of Atma Kriya Yoga in the Bhakti Marga tradition of Paramahamsa Vishwananda. The chanting can also be offered as a prayer for others.

courses.title: Jivamukti Spiritual Warrior
courses.description: A one-hour class in the Jivamukti Spiritual Warrior sequence with Inga Groth, combining a set flow with breath awareness. All levels are welcome.

courses.title: Studio classes and packages
courses.description: A weekly timetable of Kanga, Hatha, Ashtanga, Vinyasa, Yin and other classes for all levels, with meditation, pranayama and spiritual philosophy sessions. Single classes or multi-class passes can be bought, and every session is booked in advance.
